description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithPayGradeId' which implements 'ValueFormatter' to format a pay grade ID into its corresponding name within the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes dependency injection to access the PayGrade service and retrieve pay grade details.

classes.name: FormatWithPayGradeId
classes.description: A class that provides formatted string representation for pay grade IDs by retrieving the corresponding pay grade name.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the PayGrade entity based on its ID provided as 'entityValue'. Returns null if the pay grade is not found.
